scope: Focused primary-source literature review; not exhaustive or a reproduced benchmark

reading_depth_legend.full_text_selected_sections: Full paper fetched; selected relevant sections inspected, not a line-by-line proof audit
reading_depth_legend.documentation: Official documentation or repository documentation inspected
reading_depth_legend.abstract_or_record: Author abstract, publisher/institution record, or search-returned primary-source excerpt screened
reading_depth_legend.unavailable_full_text: Official bibliographic listing inspected but full paper retrieval failed

sources.title: An Architectural Description of the Simplex Architecture

sources.boundary: Specification completeness, realizability and state-space complexity

sources.title: Copilot runtime-verification framework

sources.title: Copilot 3, NASA/TM-2020-220587
sources.role: Embedded monitoring design and implementation

sources.title: R2U2 official documentation
sources.role: Current toolchain scope and bibliography

sources.type: NFM paper listed by official project
sources.role: Recent embedded implementation lead
sources.boundary: Full PDF retrieval failed; no detailed proof or performance claim used

sources.title: TeSSLa: Runtime Verification of Non-synchronized Real-Time Streams
sources.role: Asynchronous temporal stream monitoring
sources.boundary: No target cost measurements reviewed

sources.title: Runtime Verification with TeSSLa on a CPU/FPGA hybrid system
sources.role: Concrete CPU/FPGA monitoring precedent
sources.boundary: Author summary dated August 27, 2020; underlying thesis date not independently verified; implementation not reproduced

sources.title: PICARD: Parsing Incrementally for Constrained Auto-Regressive Decoding from Language Models
sources.role: Incremental parsing constraints for SQL generation
sources.boundary: SQL validity does not imply intended query correctness

sources.title: Automata-based constraints for language model decoding
sources.role: Formal treatment of tokenization and regular/deterministic context-free constraints
sources.boundary: Language membership and tokenizer assumptions, not world/task truth

sources.title: SynCode: LLM Generation with Grammar Augmentation
sources.role: DFA mask store and precise soundness/completeness conditions
sources.boundary: Paper soundness retains valid tokens; exclusion of all invalid tokens needs additional conditions; syntax only

sources.title: XGrammar: Flexible and Efficient Structured Generation Engine for Large Language Models
sources.role: Adaptive token-mask cache and persistent stacks
sources.boundary: Reported serving acceleration is not ARM/FPGA latency or WCET evidence

sources.title: XGrammar 2: Dynamic and Efficient Structured Generation Engine for Agentic LLMs
sources.role: Dynamic dispatch, JIT compilation and cross-grammar caching
sources.boundary: Dynamic structure support is not semantic task correctness or target qualification

sources.title: llguidance: Super-fast Structured Outputs
sources.role: Practical native constrained-decoding implementation candidate
sources.boundary: No published timing transferred to KR260

sources.title: llama.cpp GBNF and JSON Schema grammar documentation
sources.role: Accessible CPU control implementation, documented schema conversion limitations
sources.boundary: Subset support; unsupported features may be silently skipped; pin and test actual grammar

sources.title: JSONSchemaBench: A Rigorous Benchmark of Structured Outputs for Language Models
sources.role: 10K schemas; efficiency, constraint coverage and quality evaluation
sources.boundary: Schema success is not semantic plan accuracy or safety

sources.title: Efficient Grammar-Constrained Decoding via Parser Stack Classification
sources.type: author record states accepted by ISSTA 2026
sources.role: Preprocessing and mask computation independent of vocabulary size in its formulation
sources.boundary: Full algorithm and resource tradeoffs not audited; no board measurements

sources.title: Synchromesh: Reliable code generation from pre-trained language models
sources.role: Constrained semantic decoding for scope, typing and contextual logic
sources.boundary: Validity against declared language constraints does not ensure intended task translation

sources.title: Logically Constrained Decoding
sources.role: Domain legality and sound proof steps during decoding
sources.boundary: Proof-of-concept chess/resolution; no general task correctness, liveness or embedded qualification

sources.title: Decode-Time Grammars: Constrained LLM Generation over a Refinement Order of Grammar Fragments
sources.role: Runtime-environment slots and No-Ghost reference guarantee
sources.boundary: Reference existence is narrower than semantic task correctness; full proof/implementation not audited

sources.title: Position: LLMs Can't Plan, But Can Help Planning in LLM-Modulo Frameworks
sources.role: Architectural case for model proposals plus external verifiers
sources.boundary: Position statement, not a universal impossibility theorem about LLMs

sources.title: Robust Planning with Compound LLM Architectures: An LLM-Modulo Approach
sources.role: External sound verification and scheduling evaluation
sources.boundary: Guarantees conditional on a complete sound verifier set and formalized problem; retry boundedness separate

sources.title: Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks
sources.role: Risk-controlled rejection for pretrained classifiers
sources.boundary: Distribution/sample assumptions and coverage cost

sources.title: SelectiveNet: A Deep Neural Network with an Integrated Reject Option
sources.role: Joint learning of prediction and rejection
sources.boundary: Empirical risk-coverage improvements are not universal certified safety

sources.title: Conformal Risk Control
sources.role: Finite-sample expected monotone-loss control
sources.boundary: Not automatically accepted-set conditional risk, worst-case subgroup reliability or arbitrary-shift protection

sources.title: Learn then Test: Calibrating Predictive Algorithms to Achieve Risk Control
sources.role: Risk-control selection as multiple hypothesis testing
sources.boundary: Must instantiate valid risk, samples and threshold-search correction

sources.title: Robots That Ask For Help: Uncertainty Alignment for Large Language Model Planners
sources.role: KnowNo candidate sets, accurate-help assumption and sequence-level conformal calibration
sources.boundary: Scenario sampling, human correctness and help rate matter; marginal coverage differs from accepted-set risk

sources.title: CoFineLLM: Conformal Finetuning of LLMs for Language-Instructed Robot Planning
sources.role: Training for prediction-set efficiency and lower help rates
sources.boundary: Not inspected as an embedded runtime or formal physical-safety controller

sources.title: PLEXIL Language Reference
sources.role: Pre/postconditions, invariants and node execution semantics
sources.boundary: Correct executive behavior does not prove an arbitrary authored/generated plan meets its natural-language task

sources.title: PLEXIL Simple Unary Resources
sources.role: Explicit resource arbitration and command denial
sources.boundary: Actual tool and hardware resource models must be supplied

sources.title: Proof-Carrying Code project
sources.role: Separate untrusted construction from policy-specific trusted proof checking
sources.boundary: Architectural analogy; no existing plan-certificate implementation supplied by this review

sources.title: Control Barrier Function Based Quadratic Programs for Safety Critical Systems
sources.type: IEEE TAC paper, institutional record and author excerpt
sources.role: Safe-set invariance via constrained control
sources.boundary: Dynamics, feasibility, sampling and numerical assumptions; not language grounding

sources.title: Linear model predictive safety certification for learning-based control
sources.role: Safe-trajectory certification with minimal input modification
sources.boundary: Model/disturbance/terminal-set assumptions and per-cycle optimization cost

sources.title: Verifiable Reinforcement Learning via Policy Extraction
sources.role: VIPER distillation to verifiable decision-tree policies
sources.boundary: Symbolic-state task demonstrations; not a natural-language interpretation guarantee

sources.title: EdgeML: Resource-efficient machine learning for the edge and endpoint IoT devices
sources.type: official project and Bonsai paper excerpts
sources.role: Bonsai/ProtoNN on severely constrained microcontrollers
sources.boundary: Small model footprint is independent of semantic reliability or formal safety

sources.title: Reluplex: An Efficient SMT Solver for Verifying Deep Neural Networks
sources.role: Offline verification of bounded neural advisory properties using ACAS Xu
sources.boundary: Does not establish tractable full Qwen semantic verification or certified ACAS deployment

sources.title: QEBVerif: Quantization Error Bound Verification of Neural Networks
sources.role: Verification of errors introduced by weight and activation quantization
sources.boundary: Properties of floating-point models need not survive quantization; no transformer-scale applicability demonstrated here

sources.title: seL4 verification and real-time caveats
sources.role: Configuration-specific proof coverage and real-time isolation constraints
sources.boundary: Avoid transferring generic verification claims to KR260/DMA; some MCS status text lags newer milestones

sources.title: Proofcraft News 2026
sources.role: MCS RISC-V functional-correctness proof milestone
sources.boundary: Does not establish all security properties, all architectures or our target configuration

sources.title: LIR+LVM: Bounded execution of LLM-generated code on microcontrollers
sources.role: Publisher introduction/section excerpts screened; full-text fetch returned 403
sources.boundary: Bounded VM, capability gating and compact IR already have direct embedded prior art

sources.title: VIGIL: Defending LLM Agents Against Tool-Stream Injection via Verify-Before-Commit
sources.role: ACL 2026 publisher abstract screened
sources.boundary: Verify-before-commit alone is not novel; no reproduction or hardware implementation audited

sources.title: Stale Does Not Mean Unsafe: Guard Precision for Tool-Using LLM Agents under Infrastructure State Races
sources.role: Author abstract screened; preprint
sources.boundary: Guard granularity and benign-race availability have direct prior art; no novelty claim for read-set guards

sources.role: Defensive disclosure abstract screened, dated October 15, 2026
